scope: Read-only review of invitation position tolerance and execution-observation diagnostics. No Unity, provider calls or credentials were used for this review.

findings.result: Only Invitation accept_invite/decline_invite candidates request coordinate tolerance. Other actions and pre-continuation checks use the strict comparison.

Coordinate tolerance requires a known region and still compares space, region, radius, listener, entity list, every fact value/type/unit/source/permission field, and statement/receipt times. Public region construction rejects blank IDs; unmapped observations have null region and retain coordinate checks.

World epoch, resident revision, opportunity lifetime, decision timeout and request timeout gates remain before application. Execution rereads require matching observer/world/listener and the current world sample time.

Each ApplyReply stores its own returned observation object in the outcome; early invalidation, cancellation or null reply leaves ExecutionObservation null. The original request observation is retained.
The scheduler request, per-decision correction and rolling dispatch-budget logic is unchanged. Diagnostics do not enter NpcDecisionRequest or the explicit request codec payload.

diagnosticBoundary: A nonnull ExecutionObservation can be a rejected observer/world/time/listener result. It records what the callback returned, not that validation passed; read it with the outcome code.
remainingBoundaries: Movement that changes the nearby list or other facts remains stale; coordinate-only tolerance is not general movement tolerance.
Speech and other actions keep strict position checks. Rejected speech does not receive candidate-shape correction.
A later recorded world event may start a new decision within the existing rolling budget. This differs from retrying the same decision.
This static review alone does not prove real-scene recovery; the separate moving-scene audit reports the completed runtime evidence.
